en.title: Cornflake Chocolate Nests
en.intro:
Crunchy chocolate nests with little colourful eggs inside!

Use white chocolate for snowy nests.

steps.n1: A grown-up melts the chocolate in the microwave.
steps.n2: Add the cornflakes to the chocolate.
steps.n3: Stir gently until they are all covered.
steps.n4: Put a spoonful into each paper case.
steps.n5: Press the middle with the back of the spoon to make a nest.
steps.n6: Put little eggs in each nest!
